data.What is ISEE?: ISEE is an indicator used to assess the economic situation of families in Italy. It is required for many university services, including scholarships and fee reductions.
data.How do I apply for a residency permit?: You must apply for a residency permit (Permesso di Soggiorno) within 8 working days of your arrival in Italy. You need to get the 'Kit Giallo' from a Post Office, fill it out, and submit it.
